tools.name: quote_burofax
tools.description: Returns all-in EUR prices and inclusions for two delivery options to an address in Spain: a Correos burofax with acuse de recibo and copia certificada, and a certified notification by Notificados, a trusted third party distinct from Correos. Pricing uses the supplied page count, a character-count es

tools.name: check_spanish_address
tools.description: Checks the required fields of a Spanish postal address offline, the five-digit postcode range and the province indicated by the postcode. Returns normalised fields and a list of problems. Street existence, recipient identity and addresses outside Spain are not verified.

tools.name: create_burofax_draft
tools.description: Renders supplied, user-approved letter text and postal addresses as an A4 PDF draft in Spanish or bilingual text. Returns the page count, the price of each delivery option and a private review URL. No letter is sent and no charge is made. Payment takes place separately on the review page. Government

tools.name: get_burofax_status
tools.description: Returns the recorded status, dated timeline and available status or certificate links for an order reference, draft reference or review/status URL. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_burofax" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
